definitions.explanation: Solid waste matter discharged from the body; also the act of having a bowel movement.

examples.japanese: {大便|だいべん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大便|だいべん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pay attention to the color of your baby's stool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大便|だいべん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to submit a stool sample for my health checkup.

notes:
{大|だい} (large) + ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧ (convenience; excretion). The formal, clinical term for feces and bowel movements, used in medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大便|だいべん}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: stool test
- {大便|だいべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: have a bowel movement
- {大便|だいべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|ま}じる→混じる：02421_majiru⟧: blood in the stool
- {大便|だいべん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: stool color

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小便|しょうべん}→小便：28713_shouben⟧: urine, urination — the counterpart for liquid waste
- ⟦うんち→うんち：09084_unchi⟧: poo — the everyday, childlike word for feces
- ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧: stool — a shorter medical term often used in compounds
- ⟦{排便|はいべん}→排便：26322_haiben⟧: defecation — the formal medical term for the act of having a bowel movement

USAGE:
A clinical and formal word. In everyday speech, people use ⟦うんち→うんち：09084_unchi⟧ (childlike/casual) or ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧ (neutral). {大便|だいべん} is standard in medical forms, health checkup instructions, and scientific contexts.
